data.body_html:
Forget crowded beach bars and overpriced restaurant tables. The best seat for Marbella's New Year's Eve fireworks is on the water. A Marbella boat rental New Year's Eve 2035 fireworks experience gives you uninterrupted views of the midnight sky over Puerto Banús, with your own drinks, music, and space. Prices start at €749 for a 2-hour charter, including skipper, fuel, and a full drinks package. Here's everything you need to plan the perfect NYE afloat.

Why Watch NYE Fireworks from a Boat in Marbella?

Puerto Banús puts on a spectacular fireworks show at midnight on 31 December. From the sea, you see the bursts reflected on the water – a view you can't get from land. You avoid the crowds on the Golden Mile and the traffic jams around the port. Your boat becomes a private party venue, with space for 5 to 12 guests depending on the vessel. The sea is calm in December, and the air temperature rarely drops below 10°C. Bring a jacket, and you'll be comfortable under the stars.

Our NYE 2035 Fleet: Which Boat Is Right for You?

We have 16 boats departing from Puerto Banús. Here's a quick guide to the best options for New Year's Eve:

For Couples or Small Groups (up to 5 guests)

  • Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) – intimate and cosy
  • Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) – budget-friendly, open bow
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) – classic thrill ride

For Friends or Family (up to 11 guests)

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h, spacious cockpit
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – €749/2h, flybridge for views
  • Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax) – sporty and elegant
  • Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) – open-top performance

For a Luxury NYE Party (up to 12 guests)

  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – from €4,719/4h, includes free jet ski
  • Mangusta 80 (Grey) (24m, 12 pax) – same spec, different colour
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – ultimate luxury with enclosed saloon
  • Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax) – classic Italian style
  • Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) – flybridge with panoramic views

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA. No hidden fees.

What's Included in Your NYE Charter?

Every boat rental from [Boat Rental Marbella](/) includes:

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish VAT (21%)

You are welcome to bring your own food, decorations, and a portable speaker. We'll provide a cooler and ice.

Sample NYE 2035 Itinerary: 2-Hour Fireworks Cruise

  1. 22:30 – Board your boat at Puerto Banús. Meet your skipper, stow your bags, and get a safety briefing.
  2. 22:45 – Depart the marina. Cruise 5 minutes to the anchorage just outside the breakwater, with a direct view of the port and the Marbella coastline.
  3. 23:00–23:55 – Anchor up. Pour the cava, put on your playlist, and enjoy the lights of Puerto Banús and La Concha mountain in the distance.
  4. 00:00 – Fireworks begin. Watch the sky explode over the water. Toast with cava and eat 12 grapes (we'll provide them).
  5. 00:30 – Return to Puerto Banús. Disembark and continue your night on the Golden Mile.

How to Book Your Marbella Boat Rental for NYE 2035

NYE is our busiest night. Boats start booking from August, and the fleet is usually full by November. To secure your slot:

  1. Browse our [full fleet](/).
  2. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred boat, date, and duration.
  3. Pay a 50% deposit to hold the booking. Balance due 14 days before charter.
  4. Receive a confirmation with skipper details and boarding instructions.

For the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h minimum), the free jet ski is a popular add-on – book early to guarantee availability.

Weather and Sea Conditions for NYE in Marbella

December in Marbella sees average daytime highs of 16°C and nighttime lows of 10°C. The sea temperature is around 15°C. Winds are usually light (5–10 knots) and seas calm. Rain is possible but rare – December averages only 6 rainy days. If conditions are unsafe, we offer a full refund or reschedule. Bring a warm jacket and a blanket for open boats.
